faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the NAM Kottayam recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Programme Management & Supporting Unit, National AYUSH Mission, Kottayam District, Kerala for filling various healthcare positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under NAM Kottayam recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Physiotherapist, Therapist (Male), and Pharmacist (Homoeopathy) with a total of 3 vacancies announced across these specialized healthcare designations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of filled-up offline application forms to the designated address is 12 October 2026 up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for NAM Kottayam jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must fill out the application form and send it via post or submit it directly in a sealed envelope.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Physiotherapist post must possess a Graduation or Post Graduation degree in Physiotherapy approved by a recognized University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Pharmacist (Homoeopathy) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Pharmacist (Homoeopathy) post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 14,700/- on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants as per the notification?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 40 years as on 30 September 2026. Please check official guidelines for any applicable relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to The District Programme Manager, DPMSU, National AYUSH Mission, Inside Govt. Ayurveda Hospital, Palace Road, Vayaskara, Kottayam – 686001.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves an interview. However, a written test may be conducted if there are 20 or more applicants for a particular post.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for submitting applications to these posts under NAM Kottayam.
